MathJax browser runtime, version 4.1.3
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mathjax (Apache-2.0)
TeX extension components and MathJax-NewCM SVG font data are from @mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font 4.1.3 (Apache-2.0), published at https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font.
The complete MathJax license is in LICENSE.
Runtime code is bundled locally; the preview configures MathJax to load its TeX extensions and font data from this resource directory.
